mark_scheme.criterion: States the property of a body that resists changes in motion. Accept property of an object that resists change in motion.

hints: Recall the controlled definition of mass in Cambridge 9702 Physics.
Use the words property, body, resists, and changes in motion.
solution: Mass is the property of a body that resists changes in motion.
teacher_walkthrough: Emphasize the exact phrasing required by Cambridge: property of a body that resists changes in motion.
Remind students that mass resists acceleration, not motion itself.
